animationDesign.prohibitedShortcut: Do not stretch A02's 22-frame FightM_Punch_A clip to 48 frames and describe it as the designed sword attack.

animationDesign.contactStatus: Proposed; actual geometry overlap and event trace must agree before use.

keyPoses.pose: Ground standby with weapon clearly readable; accepted input immediately starts the arm/body response.
Readable windup silhouette; visible shoulder turn and raised blade, feet still planted.
Preparation maximum; weapon poised before the attack plane.
Contact composition: readable blade direction, turned torso, balanced feet; custom target overlaps active swept region.
Sword continues through the strike; torso and arm follow the force.
Extended finish; body begins restoring balance without appearing fully idle.
Ready to branch into a permitted next action; no-input trajectory still continues.
Return to initial standby with no positional jump.

requiredPoseChecks: Bind to actual generic-rig bones after inspecting hierarchy
No foot skating through main attack
Continuous no-input return and accepted-run blend

actualStateImplementationRequired.input: One deterministic accepted input event at boundary0 drives comparisons; buffer only the explicit requested next action.
actualStateImplementationRequired.hitDetection: Custom sword swept region against target collider enabled only inside own active interval. Hit event originates from actual overlap and is logged once, rather than a decorative collision label.
actualStateImplementationRequired.hitStop: For scene03 only, proposed six output ticks freeze both actor and target on the actual contact event. Record renderClock and simulationClock separately. Duration is our setting, never a commercial value.
actualStateImplementationRequired.cancelComparison: Scene05 disables hit stop so .8/.6/.2-second arithmetic uses the unpaused60-Hz simulation. Same clip, rig and queued-run event; only transition permission threshold36 versus48 differs.
actualStateImplementationRequired.noInput: Both policies finish their full48-frame visual clip when no next action is requested.
actualStateImplementationRequired.nextAction: Queued run transitions at boundary36 in the early-permission variant and boundary48 in the wait-to-idle variant. Record first accepted transition time.
actualStateImplementationRequired.actionMask: Running, jumping and attacking are separate eligible action types. Show the configured rule; do not imply all transitions are always enabled.
actualStateImplementationRequired.numberProvenance: All displayed48,36,60,.8,.6,.2 values are our configured/measured implementation only. Reconcile event log before publishing labels.
